title: mate-power-manager: Fix backlight-helper polkit popup
note_on_applicability_flag: The task brief flagged this PR as 'likely a package/polkit-rules fix, not a services module' to watch for. The real changed-file list ('gh pr view 540734 --json files') is: nixos/modules/services/x11/desktop-managers/mate.nix AND pkgs/by-name/ma/mate-power-manager/package.nix. mate.nix genuinely lives under nixos/modules/services/** (services/x11/desktop-managers/mate.nix) and IS touched -- the diff adds `security.polkit = { enable = true; enablePkexecWrapper = mkDefault true; };` inside the module's `config = mkIf cfg.enable { ... }` block (config-side cross-module wiring, gated on the mate desktop-manager's own enable). Since a real nixos/modules/services/** file is genuinely touched and a real wired test exists, this PR is applicable by the letter of the rule, notwithstanding that most of the functional fix lives in the package derivation (a C source substituteInPlace + configureFlags change).
watch_selection_basis: The mate.nix diff hunk (`security.polkit = { enable = true; enablePkexecWrapper = mkDefault true; };`) is a config-block assignment to a DIFFERENT module's options (security.polkit), not a declaration (mkOption/mkEnableOption/etc.) of any option belonging to services.xserver.desktopManager.mate itself. No mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule/etc. declaration line for mate's own option surface is touched anywhere in the diff. Only the baseline `enable` option (services.xserver.desktopManager.mate.enable) was watched.
